input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with An AI system is designed to understand and interpret natural language, with the goal of making informed decisions based on the context and meaning of the input. It aims to improve its performance by learning from various challenges and datasets, increasing its ability to reason and comprehend complex information. The system seeks to achieve a deeper understanding of language and its nuances, enabling it to make more accurate and informed decisions.
